Let the sums of consecutive blocks of \(n\) terms be \(B_1,B_2,B_3\).

\[
B_1=S_n=48
\]
\[
B_2=S_{2n}-S_n=60-48=12
\]

For an arithmetic sequence, these block sums form an arithmetic sequence, so

\[
B_3=2B_2-B_1=2(12)-48=-24
\]

Thus,

\[
S_{3n}=S_{2n}+B_3=60+(-24)=36
\]

\[
\boxed{36}
\]
